global_forbidden_actions: create or enable orders / broker calls / order staging
create or enable automation of any kind
use any paid API other than local Norgate access
look-ahead / use data beyond the decision month
optimized factor or ensemble weights in Phase 8A
ML fitting beyond deterministic score rules
hidden tuning / sign flipping / fitting to outcome
hallucinate data, fields, results, or API behavior

agents.name: quant-research-director
agents.objective: Own agenda, experiment budget, stop/go decisions, anti-p-hacking, final recommendation.

agents.name: data-foundation-agent
agents.objective: Norgate ingestion, normalization, data quality, survivorship audit, corporate actions, provider metadata.

agents.name: universe-construction-agent
agents.objective: Point-in-time tradable universes from membership, status, listing, liquidity.

agents.name: feature-library-agent
agents.objective: Leak-safe versioned feature panels with documented lag, source, leakage constraint.

agents.name: momentum-signal-agent
agents.objective: Momentum features and momentum strategy variants (12-1, 6-1, 3m, risk-adjusted, relative strength).

agents.name: reversal-signal-agent
agents.objective: Short-term reversal / overreaction hypotheses, bounded deterministic variants.

agents.name: volatility-liquidity-agent
agents.objective: Volatility, liquidity, turnover, dollar-volume, crowding signals.

agents.name: validation-skeptic-agent
agents.objective: Disprove every signal: leakage, placebo, cost sensitivity, year stability, regime diagnostics, holdout, multiple-testing.

agents.name: risk-portfolio-agent
agents.objective: Approved signals -> portfolio simulations with position caps, turnover, costs, drawdown, beta, concentration, sector exposure, liquidity.

agents.name: meta-model-ensemble-agent
agents.objective: Combine ONLY approved signals; correlation + ensemble readiness; no optimized weights in 8A.

agents.name: signal-publishing-agent
agents.objective: Paper-research signal previews only; no orders/broker/automation.
